borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions: <p>The proposed development results in the loss of a family-sized dwellinghouse, the need for which is clearly demonstrated in the development plan and supporting evidence base. Furthermore, the applicant fails to accurately demonstrate that there&nbsp;is an identified need for the children's home,&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;">which&nbsp;would not meet the current needs of LBBD Children’s Social Care, according to&nbsp;LBBD's Lead Commissioner in Children's Social Care</span>. As such, the proposal is considered to have a detrimental impact on the borough's supply of family housing and is contrary to the following policies:&nbsp;</p><ul><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">National Planning Policy Framework (December 2024)</span><br></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">Policiy&nbsp;D7, H1, H12 and S2 of the London Plan (March 2021)</span><br></li><li style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 11pt;">Policies SP3 and&nbsp;SPDG1 of the Barking and Dagenham Local Plan 2037 (September 2024)</span></li></ul>
description: Change of use of the dwelling (Use Class C3) to a children's care home for up to 2 child residents aged 7- 18 with two rotating overnight carers and a day manager (Use Class C2)
